facts.fact: On 21 January 2026 the Union Cabinet approved continuing the Atal Pension Yojana (APY) up to FY 2030-31
facts.quote: Posted On: 21 JAN 2026 12:22PM by PIB Delhi The Union Cabinet chaired by the Prime Minister, Shri Narendra Modi, today approved the continuation of Atal Pension Yojana (APY) up to FY 2030-31

facts.fact: Government funding support for promotional and developmental activities (awareness, capacity building) continues until 2030-31
facts.quote: The scheme will continue up to 2030-31 with Government support for: Promotional and Developmental activities to expand outreach among unorganised workers including awareness, capacity building.

facts.fact: Gap funding to meet viability requirements also continues until 2030-31
facts.quote: Gap funding to meet viability requirements and ensure sustainability of the scheme.

facts.fact: APY gives a guaranteed minimum pension of Rs 1,000 to Rs 5,000 per month from age 60, based on contributions
facts.quote: APY offers a guaranteed minimum pension of Rs.1,000 to Rs.5,000 per month starting at age 60, based on contributions.
APY was launched on 9 th May, 2015 with the objective of providing old-age income security to workers in the unorganised sector.

facts.fact: Over 8.66 crore subscribers were enrolled as of 19 January 2026
facts.quote: As of 19 th January, 2026, over 8.66 crore subscribers have been enrolled

summary: PIB 21 Jan 2026 still confirms APY continued up to FY 2030-31 with promotional and gap funding; features and figures unchanged.
